317-1475-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

728-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
728-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

1456-5078-7060-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-1070-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-4050.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2866-3899-4808-4986.description:
Cast Black Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Black Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

215-4188-7297.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-7297.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2624-4452-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Oketra.
When God-Eternal Oketra dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Oketra's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Oketra.
As God-Eternal Oketra is a Lhurgoyf due to Rukarumel, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Oketra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2724-3080-5299-6433.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Flickerform by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling and returning (at end step) itself and Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

372-4823-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4823-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

236-1978-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
236-1978-7434--148.description:
Animate Brass Infiniscope.
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
236-1978-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

4996-7428.description:
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.

1806-2060-6627-6797-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to The Earth Crystal.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2511-5075-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2511-5075-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands

1486-1719-1753-7223.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.
1486-1719-1753-7223.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

486-1978-7203.description:
Cause Brigid to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brigid.
Repeat from step 2.

38-1385-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3661-5220-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2757-5051-5078-6918.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Traxos, untapping a basic land.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3129-4636-4772-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

1491-4474-4565-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

341-1020-1117-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1385-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1385-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4050-4770-4772-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cats, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

618-5361.notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier is a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
618-5361.description:
Activate Auton Soldier by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste that will be sacrificed at the next end step.
The Auton Soldier token enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Kiki-Jiki with an additional +1/+1 counter.
Activate the Auton Soldier token by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste, exile that token at the end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

678-4050-4151-5334.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
678-4050-4151-5334.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

1506-1636-3888-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Olivia's Attendants.
Olivia's Attendants does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Olivia's Attendants indestructible.
1506-1636-3888-4694.description:
Give Olivia's Attendants indestructible, if needed.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating that many Blood artifact tokens.
The Bloods enter the battlefield as 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat from step ? for each remaining trigger, skipping step ? on the last trigger.
Repeat from step 2.

985-3110-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

575-897-4677-4955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
575-897-4677-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Branchsnap Lorian.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Branchsnap Lorian enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1284-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
1284-3957.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1806-4204-4772-5296.description:
Activate Varolz by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, regenerating Varolz.
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability by paying {3} and exiling it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1109-1636-5256-5319.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Geralf's Messenger does not have any +1/+1 counters.
1109-1636-5256-5319.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger.
Geralf's Messenger dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Geralf's Messenger's power.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Geralf's Messenger.
Repeat.

646-679-1742.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
646-679-1742.description:
During your draw step, before you draw a card, activate Words of Worship by paying {1}, causing you to gain five life the next time you would draw a card this turn.
Move to draw a card, instead gaining five life due to Words of Worship.
Lich's Mastery's first ability triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Activate Words of Worship by paying {1}, causing you to gain five life the next time you would draw a card this turn.
Resolve Lich's Mastery, causing you to draw four cards and gain five life.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3490-3597.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Juri triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
2034-3490-3597.notes: You can sacrifice Juri to deal infinite damage to any target once you stop the loop.
